item.description:
Important

  • Requires macOS 14.6 (Sonoma) or newer.

New Features

  • Default Format Selection: Added the long-awaited ability to change your default conversion format (choose between JPEG, PNG, HEIC, or WEBP) to speed up repetitive workflows.
  • Conversion Presets: You can now create and select custom conversion presets directly in the 'Advanced Conversion' window. Presets can also be imported and exported via the 'Settings' window.
  • Enhanced Renaming Controls: Upgraded the file renaming capabilities to provide significantly more flexibility and structural control.
  • JPEG/JPG Toggle: Added a dedicated switch to seamlessly swap your output extension between .jpeg and .jpg.
  • Arrow Key Navigation: You can now use the keyboard arrow keys to quickly increment or decrement numerical values within the 'Advanced Conversion' window.
  • Skip Multi-Frame Conversions: Introduced a toggle that allows you to skip the multi-frame conversion process for GIFs and video files.

Fixes & Improvements

  • Modernised Interface: Restyled the 'Settings' and 'Advanced Conversion' windows for a cleaner, modern aesthetic. The 'Introduction' window has also been unified with the 'Settings' window for a smoother onboarding experience.
  • Golden Gate Support: Added compatibility for MacOS 27, resolving a bug that previously affected window controls on this version.
  • Notification Permissions: Fixed an issue with app alerts by adding a system settings popup prompt when enabling notifications.
  • Better SVG Handling: Improved the overall reliability and output quality of SVG conversions.
  • Suffix Text Selection: Fixed a bug to ensure CMD+A now successfully selects all text when editing the file name suffix in the 'Settings' window.
  • Streamlined Modifiers: Removed the 'Recursive Folder' and 'Force Delete' modifier keys to simplify the interface.
